title: post_classification
description: Enrichment (Phase 4) — one content_item LLM classifier output. Per-item evidence only; no aggregation path to any per-ticker win rate (survivorship firewall). See data-dictionary.md §8.2 and data-model.md §5.4.
x-constraint: SURVIVORSHIP FIREWALL: reported_pnl/win_loss/yolo_usd are per-item evidence only — NO aggregation path to any per-ticker win rate.

platform.description: Community source of the classified content_item.

is_option_play.description: Whether the post is an options trade vs shares.

llm_stance.description: LLM-assessed stance (stronger than keyword net_dir): bull / bear / neutral.

yolo_usd.description: Position size extracted from text or screenshots. Per-item evidence — never aggregated to a win rate.

reported_pnl.description: Self-reported profit/loss. Per-item evidence — never aggregated to a per-ticker rate.

win_loss.description: Outcome label: win / loss / breakeven. Per-item only — survivorship firewall prohibits aggregation.
